entities.summary: Conor Kostick is a historian and writer living in Dublin. He is the author of many works of history and fiction. A former chairperson of the Irish Writers Union and member of the board of the National Library of Ireland, he has won a number of awards. Conor Kostick was a authors & novelists from Chester (b. 1964-06-26, Chester). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
